# Global Plus Business Group

> A diversified Ethiopian business group spanning export & agribusiness, manufacturing, construction, minerals, and international trade & distribution — connecting Ethiopia to global markets.

Global Plus Business Group is headquartered in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, and operates across five divisions:

- **Export & Agribusiness** — Ethiopian coffee, tea, oilseeds, pulses, cereals, spices and flowers for international markets. https://globalplus.com.et/businesses/agribusiness
- **Manufacturing & Industrial** — Metal products, electrical equipment, cement, lime, plaster and industrial inputs. https://globalplus.com.et/businesses/manufacturing
- **Construction & Infrastructure** — Building, road and waterworks contracting, engineering coordination and project delivery. https://globalplus.com.et/businesses/construction
- **Trading & Distribution** — Import, distribution and trade representation across ICT, electrical goods, stationery, chemicals, plastics and consumer inputs. https://globalplus.com.et/businesses/trading
- **Minerals & Resources** — Responsible sourcing, certification and export of precious, semi-precious, metallic and industrial minerals. https://globalplus.com.et/businesses/minerals
